literal_meaning: to apply or stick a mark or stain
figurative_meaning_en: to incur a fault or blemish on one's reputation
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নামে এই ঘটনায় দাগ লেগেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A stain has been put on the leader's character.
This incident has left a blemish on his name.
note: Commonly used in contexts of moral or reputational damage in Bengali discourse.
